forum.title: Does STM32H563ZIT3Q have Ehternet?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @DPB and welcome to the ST community,

As said by @Andrew Neil you need to refer to the datasheet of the product.

STM32H563ZIT3**Q**

**Q means SMPS:**

![mALLEm_1-1778497918488.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/d06694ac-e2ae-bf04-6f17-80997c4d6991.png "mALLEm_1-1778497918488.png")

And from this table, its doesn't support Ethernet interface:

![mALLEm_0-1778499894143.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/4b60d4ee-e1b6-6be8-c796-ea5b8d4e2c81.png "mALLEm_0-1778499894143.png")

You need to use **LDO** package to have Ethernet.

Hope that answers your question.
forum.content_text:
Hi, is anybody able to confirm if the STM32H563ZIT3Q has an ethernet peripheral?

Thanks, regards.
